scripts.build: pnpm --filter @one-esp/protocol build && pnpm --filter @one-esp/bridge build && pnpm --filter @one-esp/web build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @one-esp/protocol build && pnpm --filter @one-esp/bridge typecheck && pnpm --filter @one-esp/web typecheck
scripts.test:firmware: uv run --locked python -B -m unittest discover -s apps/firmware/tests -v
scripts.test:tools: uv run --locked python -B -m unittest discover -s tools/tests -v
scripts.lint: oxlint packages/protocol/src apps/bridge/src apps/web/src && eslint apps/web/src
